description: This file declares the Pause class, which is a task for pausing a Web Audio player within the Rialto server component. It includes necessary headers, defines the class with constructor, destructor, and execute method, and contains private members for the player and client interfaces.

classes.name: Pause
classes.description: A class representing a pause task for the Web Audio player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pause task with references to the player and client.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pause operation on the Web Audio player.
